description: Check the status of one of your video jobs by task_id (from generate_video) or job_id. Returns status, a viewable view_url when finished, or the error if it failed (a video Higgsfield Genjutsu turned down is moved to Seedance 2.5 by Switch: it stays in progress with moved true, then becomes that video, so keep checking the same id and never start another one), plus the whole prompt (prompt_full) and every reference the video was made with (references: pictures, clips and sounds in their original order, each with its @tag, folder, file and a fresh url), so it can be made again exactly. Poll this every ~20s — do not loop rapidly.
name: get_video_status
title: Get Video Status
